function.name: light_travel_time

But the function expects distance in light years, so it will compute time in seconds? The function likely returns time in seconds or maybe years. We need to decide. The user likely expects answer: 4 years. But we can also show calculation: 4 light-years = 4 * (365.25 days * 24 * 3600 s) = about 1.261e8 seconds? Wait 1 year ~ 31557600 s. So 4 years ~ 1.262304e8 s. But we can use function.
